quests.name: Trouble with Bats
quests.summary: The banker wants the bat near Pelenstead thinned out.
intro: The bat beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 9 of them close to Pelenstead and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Raw Salmon
quests.summary: The general store keeper of Pelenstead has run out of raw salmon.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 14 raw salmon and nobody in Pelenstead has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Banker
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Pelenstead to the banker.
intro: This should have gone to the banker days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the barber.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Armour Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the armour shop keeper of Pelenstead and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the armour shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The sword shop keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Pelenstead Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Pelenstead Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Pelenstead Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Bats (Magic Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: The magic shop keeper wants the bat near Pelenstead thinned out.
intro: The bat beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 9 of them close to Pelenstead and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Coal
quests.summary: The clothes shop keeper of Pelenstead has run out of coal.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 18 coal and nobody in Pelenstead has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Clothes Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Pelenstead to the clothes shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the clothes shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the food shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Sweeping the Pelenstead Sewers
quests.summary: Clear crawling hand out of Pelenstead Sewers and tell the fishing shop keeper.
intro: Pelenstead Sewers is crawling with crawling hand, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 14 of them, then let the fishing shop keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Pelenstead owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Pelenstead Sewers is clearer than it was. 14 crawling hand fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Fenoburn
quests.summary: Gather willow logs for the general store keeper, then carry a shipment to Fenoburn.
intro: I have an order from Fenoburn and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 18 willow logs, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the general store keeper in Pelenstead.
From Pelenstead? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Pelenstead and bring back coal.
intro: The wilds around Pelenstead need a firm hand. Start with 9 bat outside the walls, then 14 giant rat down in Pelenstead Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 18 coal to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Pelenstead for the sword shop keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the magic shop keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The sword shop keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the barber does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the magic shop keeper.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Pelenstead Sewers (Archery Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Clear rogue out of Pelenstead Sewers and tell the clothes shop keeper.

outro: Both done? Pelenstead owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Pelenstead Sewers is clearer than it was. 14 rogue fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

Bring me 11 bones, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council (Food Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Gather support around Pelenstead for the food shop keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the realtor, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The food shop keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the staff shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the realtor.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Frostbite Cavern, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Frostbite Cavern has stood against Pelenstead for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the fishing shop keeper, fight your way through 22 giant spider and end The Broodmother.
Bring 18 coal back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Frostbite Cavern?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Pelenstead: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.

quests.name: The Pelenstead Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Pelenstead and Fenoburn.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Fenoburn. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 22 bat near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the banker underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the sword shop keeper in Pelenstead.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Fenoburn is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Pelenstead has not had news this good in years.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Pelenstead
quests.summary: Find what rules Pelenstead Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Ooze Mother.
intro: Something rules Pelenstead Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the banker what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Pelenstead is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Ooze Mother.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Ooze Mother is dead. Pelenstead Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.
